requirements.description: Consultant must immediately disclose any actual or potential conflict of interest
Consultant must maintain commercial general liability insurance of minimum $5,000,000
Consultant must submit invoices within 10 Business Days of payment period end with required details
Consultant must cease work and report any found substances encountered at project site immediately
Rates represent full amount chargeable including all taxes, fees, labour, materials, travel, insurance and overhead
City may hold back or set off payment if Consultant fails to comply and does not rectify within 7 days of notice
Consultant must identify and disclose Conflicts of Interest during procurement and perform work, including unfair advantage in procurement or preferred treatment communications
Consultant must have Consultant's own power to contract and representatives authorized to bind Consultant per Article 3.01-3.02

Consultant shall provide post-facilitation support per participant within each Cohort, including addressing participant questions and assessing assignments. Pricing based on 3 hours per participant per Cohort.
Pricing must be provided for one sample cohort only, not annual, multiple cohorts, or total contract term
Highest Rated Negotiations proponent must provide cost breakdown form for Items 1 and 2
Yellow cells in Excel pricing form require lump sum price for each cohort scenario provided; customization level based on employee role (Individual Contributor vs. Senior Leader)
Pricing and proposal scope limited to services defined in RFP. Additional services (coaching, psychometric assessments) are not included and must not be priced separately.
Alberta incorporation/registration required under Business Corporations Act to legally carry on business in Alberta, regardless of incorporation jurisdiction
Travel costs must be captured within Price Form and incorporated into overall pricing formula for evaluation and scoring
Account Manager may be separate individual from L&D SME if needed for program design and content guidance
Proponents must include travel costs within Price Form; travel costs incorporated into overall pricing formula for evaluation and scoring.

supplemental_synthetic._note: SYNTHETIC -- not live data. Stand-ins for main-RFP obligations that are absent from the live bid (the main RFP document was never uploaded). Wording is generic procurement language, not a quotation of the Calgary RFP.

requirements.description: Where a proposal is submitted jointly by more than one party (a joint bid / consortium), each party must complete and sign the Multi-Party Confirmation Form.
The Submission Form must be completed and signed by an authorized signatory, including the acknowledgement of addenda and the conflict of interest declaration.
Proponents must complete the supplier questionnaire directly in the Ariba portal.
Describe the proposed methodology and six-stage programme delivery approach, including goals, objectives and how success measures are evaluated.

evaluation_criteria.prompt: Describe the methodology, delivery modalities and programme design approach.
Describe the experience and qualifications of the facilitators and account manager.

evaluation_criteria.prompt: Describe governance, quality assurance and evaluation of learning outcomes.
